findings.source_quote: Many speculations have been made regarding the cause of the mental distress which prompted the author to write this text.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “geestelike nood” with “innerlike nood” or “emosionele nood” to retain the sense of mental distress without suggesting spiritual distress.
findings.translation_quote: Daar is baie bespiegel oor die oorsaak van die geestelike nood wat die skrywer aangespoor het om hierdie teks te skryf.
